summary: Access request: GitHub permissions for statuspage component registry updates + review workflow
description:
Requesting GitHub access required to update and review the public status page component registry (component ids/display names/ownership/rollout flags) as part of the “Status page transparency upgrades” initiative.

Background / why:
- We’re moving the component mapping + registry to a repo-backed source of truth per ADR-014.
- Ongoing work requires occasional edits to the registry + mapping rules (new components, ownership changes, hotfixes for misclassification).
- Current state: I can open PRs but cannot (a) merge after required reviews, and (b) update CODEOWNERS/team review requirements for the registry path. This is blocking taxonomy rollout and on-call readiness.

Access requested:
1) Add me (Christine Wong) to GitHub team with write access to the repo(s) that contain the registry + mapping config:
   - repo: observability-pack (registry schema + registry JSON)
   - repo: incident-bot (intake fields + enforcement)
   - repo: redwood (service-to-component mapping layer)
2) Add me to the reviewers/owners group for the registry directory so I can participate in required review flows (not bypass them).

Scope / guardrails:
- Least-privilege preferred: write access + PR merge rights constrained to these repos; no admin access needed.
- Maintain review requirements: changes to registry should continue to require SRE/Observability review (Rafael Mendes / Allison Grant or delegates).

People to include (if applicable):
- Christine Wong (requester; implementer)
- Ravi Menon (service-to-component mapping)
- Devon Price (incident-bot automation engineer)

Target date:
- Needed by EOW to unblock component taxonomy rollout work in ENG-4821/ENG-4830 and avoid last-minute manual edits during staged rollout.

Approval:
- Rafael Mendes (SRE delivery lead) is aware/approved in the project channel; can confirm if needed.

resolution: Granted scoped GitHub write access via new team “statuspage-registry-maintainers” to required repos (observability-pack, incident-bot, redwood). Branch protections and required reviews remain in place. CODEOWNERS updates routed separately to repo owners per agreed owner groups (SRE + Observability).
